OrganizationUpdateRequest.description: Organization update request. Full update: every field is applied, and a null optional field clears the stored value.

description.description: Organization description. Null clears the stored value. An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected.

industry.description: Industry. Null clears the stored value. An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected.

companySize.description: Company size. Null clears the stored value. An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected.

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3). Null clears the stored value. An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected.

website.description: Website URL. Null clears the stored value. An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected.
